plan_point: 77.44.7.D / EDT-015 — published tabs after mobile viewport resize

finding.failure: At 390x640 after the live page viewport changed, the keyboard test did not move the selected public tab; the full CI log shows a waitForFunction timeout at the assertion following ArrowRight.
finding.diagnosis: A minimal real-Chromium fixture with two open pages reproduces the tab runtime correctly at both 390x640 and 720x450 when the target page is brought forward, the tab is focused, and the key is pressed through that tab locator. The failure belongs to focus orchestration in the larger multi-page browser test, not a demonstrated public runtime defect.
finding.fix: The browser helper now brings the published page to the foreground, restores DOM focus to the target tab, waits for that focus, and sends the real key through the focused tab locator after each viewport change. ARIA, roving tabindex, panel content, focus, and geometry checks remain intact.
